dialogue.content: (こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になったら始めさせていただきます。)
dialogue.English: (Hello. I look forward to our session today. We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。始めにご年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 23 男　会社に行くのが辛い
dialogue.English: 23, male. It's hard for me to go to work.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。会社に行くのがお辛いということで、それは悩まれますよね。何があったか、理由を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. You said it's hard for you to go to work; that must be very troubling. Could you tell me what happened, or the reason why?

dialogue.content: 今の会社を今月末で辞めて、来月違う会社に行くのですが、居場所が無くて辛いです
dialogue.English: I'm leaving my current company at the end of this month and starting at a different one next month, but I feel like I don't have a place where I belong, and it's hard.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、今の会社を辞めること決まり、居場所が無いと感じておられるんですね？
dialogue.English: I see. So you've decided to leave your current company, and you're feeling like you don't belong there, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それはなんとなく行くのが辛くなりますよね。居場所が無いということですが、どういう時にそう感じるか具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I can understand how that would make it difficult to go to work. You mentioned feeling like you don't have a place; could you tell me specifically when you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 会社にいる時です
dialogue.English: When I'm at the office.

dialogue.content: なるほど、会社にいるときはいつもそう感じるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you always feel that way when you're at the office?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。何か言われたりされたりされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Has anyone said or done anything to you?

dialogue.content: よくわかりません
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure.

dialogue.content: なるほど。では具体的に何か言われたとかではないとしたら、相談者さんが特に居場所が無いと感じられる場面や、人などあれば教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So if it's not something specific that was said, could you tell me about any particular situations or people that make you feel like you don't belong?

dialogue.content: 仕事がないこと
dialogue.English: Not having any work to do.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それでは職場に居てる間、居場所無く感じられて当然ですね。それは辞表を出されてから急に仕事をもらえなくなったという事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, then it's understandable that you'd feel out of place while you're at the office. Did you suddenly stop being given work after you submitted your resignation?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか・・・以前からそれがお辞めになる直接の理由なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that so... Was this an ongoing issue and the direct reason you decided to quit?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: では他に理由があったのでしょうか？もしよければお話できる範囲で結構ですので教えていただけませんか？
dialogue.English: Then were there other reasons? If you're comfortable, could you tell me as much as you feel able to share?

dialogue.content: 人間関係が辛かったからです
dialogue.English: Because the interpersonal relationships were difficult.

dialogue.content: それはいろいろ悩まれた上でのご判断だったのですね。。どなたとの人間関係が辛かったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you made your decision after a lot of thought. May I ask with whom the relationships were difficult?

dialogue.content: 言いたくないです
dialogue.English: I'd rather not say.

dialogue.content: わかりました。ではこれから先、社内でどうしたいとか希望はありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. In that case, do you have any hopes for how you'd like things to be at the office from now on?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 初めに社内で居場所が無いとご相談いただきましたが、どうなればよいと思っておられますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned at the beginning that you feel you don't have a place at the company. What do you think would make it better?

dialogue.content: どうなればいいんですかね
dialogue.English: I wonder what would be good.

dialogue.content: すみません、ご相談内容の確認ですが、お辞めになる現会社での居場所が欲しいというご相談でいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I'd just like to confirm what we're discussing. Is it correct that you want to find a sense of belonging at the company you're about to leave?

dialogue.content: 居場所が欲しいとは言ってません
dialogue.English: I didn't say I want a place to belong.

dialogue.content: すみません、ではどういうご相談なのかをもう少し詳しく教えていただけませんか？
dialogue.English: I apologize. Could you please explain in a little more detail what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 最初にお話しましたけど
dialogue.English: I already told you at the beginning.

dialogue.content: 居場所がないということでしたが、そのご相談ということで始めお聞きしましたが、でも欲しくはないということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understood that you wanted to talk about feeling like you don't have a place, but are you saying you don't actually want one?

dialogue.content: まあそうです
dialogue.English: Pretty much, yes.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・。特に今の会社で解決することも無さそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see... Does it seem like there's nothing in particular to resolve at your current company?

dialogue.content: 今月で辞めるのに解決してどうにかなるものなのでしょうか
dialogue.English: I'm quitting at the end of the month, so what good would resolving it do now?

dialogue.content: そうですね、それはご納得されているのですね。私もそう思います。では次の会社に前向きに気持ちを切り替えておられるということですね？
dialogue.English: You're right, I see you've come to terms with that. I agree. Does that mean you're shifting your focus positively toward the next company?

dialogue.content: なんでそう決めつけられるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Why are you making that assumption?

dialogue.content: 決めつけているわけでは無いつもりでしたが、不愉快に感じられたなら申し訳ありませんでした。次の会社は決まっておられますか？
dialogue.English: I didn't mean to make an assumption, and I apologize if it made you feel uncomfortable. Do you have your next job lined up?

dialogue.content: 最初に話しましたけど
dialogue.English: I told you at the beginning.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。しっかり次は決めておられるということで安心しました。今の会社にあと何日くらい通勤すれば辞められそうですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'm relieved to hear that you have your next step firmly in place. About how many more days do you have to commute to your current company before you leave?

dialogue.content: 2週間
dialogue.English: Two weeks.

dialogue.content: そうですか。その二週間はどう感じられますか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel about those two weeks?

dialogue.content: 辛い
dialogue.English: It's hard.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。お辛いとは思います。そのような相談者さんのご事情を相談できる方は周りにおられますか？
dialogue.English: I understand; I imagine it's very hard. Is there anyone around you you can talk to about your situation?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それは余計にお辛くなりますね。職場の方以外で相談したりできる方はいますか？
dialogue.English: I see, that must make it even harder. Is there anyone outside of work you can talk to?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうですか、辛い気持ちを一人で抱えて我慢されていたのですね。それでも着実に次の事を考えて行動されている相談者さんなら、どうすべきかすでにお考えの事だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, you've been enduring these difficult feelings all by yourself. Even so, since you're steadily thinking about and acting on your next steps, I imagine you already have an idea of what you should do.

dialogue.content: もう少しお気持ちを聞きたかったのですが、相談終了時間が近づきました。何か他に私に出r来そうなことはございますか？
dialogue.English: I would have liked to hear a little more about how you're feeling, but our session time is coming to an end. Is there anything else I can do for you?

dialogue.content: 特にないです
dialogue.English: Not particularly.

dialogue.content: わかりました。今日はお忙しい中相談に来ていただきありがとうございました。また何かお力になれそうなことがあればこの相談室に来ていただければ嬉しく思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule to come in today. If there's anything else I might be able to help with in the future, I'd be happy to see you here again.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした。この後終了メッセージ送信で、ロープレ完了をお願いします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. After you send the closing message, the role-play will be complete.)
